# Full-lifetime duration weights in seconds for self-host e2e sharding.

# e7801485 and 209a7378), read from the verify job's "measured durations"
# group (scripts/ci-test-weights merge, docs/CI-WEIGHT-REFRESH.md) with
# `scripts/ci-test-weights refresh`: each entry is ceil(the slower of the two
# observations); lowering requires both runs. Entries whose replacement rounds
# to one second are omitted, since tests absent from this file weigh 1, as
# are the tests the runs measured that the tree has since deleted.
# All registered tests are still assigned exactly once by scripts/shard-tests.

# The ISOLATED_DRIVER_TESTS of test-e2e-selfhost.yml run in the cli job, not
# the shards; their rows come from that job's own timing artifact and steer
